column4: OS sandbox is off by default; set sandbox.enabled=true (or run /sandbox) and keep allowUnsandboxedCommands=false.
Auto-review runs non-allowlisted commands in an OS sandbox when possible; never pick Run Everything (no sandbox); tune .cursor/sandbox.json.
Keep sandbox_mode=workspace-write (or read-only) in ~/.codex/config.toml; never use danger-full-access, --yolo or --dangerously-bypass-approvals-and-sandbox.
Sandbox is off by default; set tools.sandbox=true in .gemini/settings.json (or pass -s); never use --yolo.
No OS sandbox (permissions are app-level); deny destructive bash patterns in opencode.json and run it in a dev container or VM.
Only the VS Code agent has a sandbox, off by default (chat.agent.sandbox.enabled); Copilot CLI documents none, so avoid --allow-all/--yolo and use a dev container or VM.
No sandbox documented; avoid Turbo auto-execution, keep a deny list, and run it in a dev container or VM.
Local backend has no sandbox; set terminal.backend to a container backend in ~/.hermes/config.yaml and never use --yolo or approvals.mode=off.
No OS sandbox documented; deny shell and fs_write patterns in ~/.kiro/settings/permissions.yaml (deny beats allow) and use a dev container or VM.
Safety depends on whichever agent reads .agents/skills; see docs/host-safety.md for each agent.
